skill1: Hero Vision: Explosion Radius ▲ 3.57%, stacks up to 5 time(s) and lasts for 15 sec. (the STAT magnitude and the 15 sec decay are unmodeled — there is no Explosion-Radius StatKey and AoE radius moves no damage on a single partless boss; the 0-5 stack COUNT itself IS modeled, as the heroVision resource that gates the burst's true-damage branches)
skill2: Activates when hitting the target's Parts. Affects the target's body. Deals 14.78% of final ATK as additional damage. (the scope-lock boss is partless and the engine has no parts-hit channel; NOT proxied by requiresCore — a core hit is not a parts hit, and proxying would fabricate damage)
burst: Note: Unable to take cover while using Burst Skill. (defensive-only; the v1 boss deals no damage, so cover state is inert)

caveats: ⚑ Burst weapon-swap shot economy is KIT-SILENT and dominates burst damage: pullsPerSec and maxAmmo are left unset (engine inherits the base RL economy: 6 ammo / 161f reload) and chargeTimeSec is set to 0 on a reasoned read, not a measurement. Total swap-window damage is therefore UNTRUSTED until popups in a real 10s window are counted.

⚑ heroVision is modeled as a non-decaying 0-5 resource; the kit's 15 sec per-stack expiry is not expressible on a resource pool. Assumes she keeps the stack at cap between full charges (charge ≈ 60f, so 5 charges arrive well inside 15s).

⚑ 'Attacking with Full Charge' is proxied by trigger shotFired + swapGate unswapped (every base-weapon pull on a charge weapon is a full charge in the sim). Any partial-charge tap would over-fire both skill1 stacking and the skill2 132.45% rider.

⚑ The burst's 11.9% true-damage line carries NO activation clause; modeled as a per-swap-shot rider (shotFired + swapGate swapped) gated at max stacks. It could instead be a one-shot on-cast splash or scoped to the First Damage hit only.

⚑ First Damage 1455.72% is encoded as a burstCast flatDamage rider, so it gets crit at the sheet rate but NO core bucket — yet in-game it is the swap weapon's opening rocket and may well core. If footage shows a red CORE HIT popup at burst cast, this needs core handling.
⚑ crit:true on both true-damage riders follows the rider-crit convention, not a measurement for this unit.
noFb is deliberately unset everywhere (Full Burst by timing, default ON); noRange is left to the engine.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Laplace (Treasure) is an RL/Iron/Attacker Burst III charge unit modeled as: (1) skill1 — each full charge banks one Hero Vision stack (0-5), tracked as the heroVision resource because the stack COUNT is load-bearing (it gates the burst's true-damage branches) while the Explosion Radius ▲ 3.57% stat itself has no engine StatKey and moves no damage on a single partless boss; (2) skill2 — a 132.45% of final ATK rider on every full-charge hit (crit-eligible, no core, base weapon only); the parts-hit 14.78% branch is unmodeled because the boss has no parts; (3) burst — a 10s weapon swap at 22.2% per shot, Pierce-tagged on the swapped weapon (weaponSwap.hasPierce, NOT the whole-fight hasPierce flag), split into two mutually exclusive resource-gated blocks so trueNormals turns on only at 5 Hero Vision stacks, plus the 1455.72% First Damage as a burstCast hit (FB-exempt by cast timing) and an 11.9% true-damage per-shot rider gated at max stacks. The largest open risk is the swap window's shot count — the kit states no cadence or ammo for the swapped weapon, so the burst total is a floor, not a value.

flags.estimate: chargeTimeSec set to 0 (non-charge swap weapon); pullsPerSec and maxAmmo LEFT UNSET so the engine inherits the base RL economy (6 ammo, 161f reload). Expected ~6-8 swapped shots in the 10s window ⇒ only ~130-180% of final ATK of normal damage, i.e. under 15% of the burst's total next to the 1455.72% First Damage.
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #3: weapon-swap shot economy is kit-silent. Whole-picture: 22.2% per shot is ~1/3 of her 63.11% base normal multiplier, which is inconsistent with a 1s-charge-per-shot cycle (that would make the swap strictly worse than her base weapon) and consistent with a rapid non-charge stream — hence chargeTimeSec 0. But I will NOT invent a pulls/s or an ammo count: guessing a precise ⚑ is worse than flagging it. If the real weapon fires ~3-4/s with effectively continuous ammo, the swap's normal damage (and every 11.9% true rider hanging off it) is under-credited by several-fold.
flags.recipe: From one recorded Laplace burst: count normal-damage popups between the burst banner and +10s ⇒ effective pulls/s; note any reload gap ⇒ maxAmmo (or unlimitedAmmo if none). Cross-check the smallest popup value against 22.2% × final ATK to confirm the per-shot multiplier, then set pullsPerSec/maxAmmo (or add an unlimitedAmmo effect) from the count, not from the datamined base row.

flags.estimate: No decay modeled; stacks ratchet 0→5 over the first 5 full charges (~first 10-15s of the fight) and then sit at cap for the rest of the fight, so every burst after the first ~15s takes the max-stack (true-damage) branch.
flags.reasoning: The kit says each stack lasts 15 sec, but a resource pool has no expiry and a maxStacks buff cannot be read by resourceGate — so a threshold gate and a decaying stack cannot both be expressed with the current primitives. The approximation is benign only if her charge cadence stays under 15s per shot, which it does at 60 charge frames + a 161f reload; it becomes wrong if she idles (boss downtime / cover phases) long enough to drop stacks right before a burst.
flags.recipe: Check a recording for a burst cast after a long non-firing stretch (boss transition or cover phase): if the burst's normal popups are DEF-reduced rather than true, the decay is live and the burst branch needs a real time-window model (or an engine primitive for expiring stacks readable by a gate).

flags.estimate: Damage-inert: 0 credited (5 stacks × 3.57% = 17.85% radius modeled as nothing).
flags.reasoning: There is no Explosion-Radius StatKey, and against a single partless boss a larger AoE has nowhere to expand into. projectileExplosionPct is a Damage-Up stat ('Projectile Explosion Damage'), a DIFFERENT mechanic from radius — reusing it would fabricate ~18% Damage-Up she was never granted. Treated as inert with the stack count preserved as the mechanically load-bearing half.
flags.recipe: Solo her against the scope-lock boss and compare per-shot base-weapon popup values at 0 stacks (first shot) vs 5+ stacks with all other buffs held constant. Equal values ⇒ radius is confirmed damage-inert here. Any lift ⇒ it needs a real stat and this row is wrong.

flags.estimate: shotFired + swapGate 'unswapped' (fires once per base-weapon pull).
flags.reasoning: There is no fullCharge trigger; on a charge weapon the sim always releases at full charge, so shotFired is exact under current engine behaviour. chargeCounter{count:1} would express it more literally but relies on the cycling-phase reset semantics for a single-phase block. The swapGate is required so the non-charging burst weapon neither stacks Hero Vision nor re-fires the 132.45% rider.
flags.recipe: Confirm from footage that no 132.45% rider popup and no Hero Vision stack tick occurs during the 10s burst window; if either does, the swap weapon counts as full-charge and the swapGate must be dropped.

flags.field: override.burst[3] — trigger for the 11.9% true-damage line
flags.estimate: Per swap shot (shotFired + swapGate swapped), gated at max stacks; ⇒ same count as the swap's normal shots, so its total inherits the swap-economy uncertainty above.
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #2: the line has NO activation clause — 'Affects the same enemy unit(s)' only names a target set. Read as a rider on the swap weapon's hits since that is the only ongoing damage in the block. The competing reads are a single on-cast splash (≈1 instance instead of N) or a rider on the First Damage hit only; those differ by an order of magnitude in total.
flags.recipe: In a max-stack burst, count 11.9%-magnitude popups and compare to the count of 22.2% normal popups. 1:1 ⇒ per-shot rider (as modeled); exactly one ⇒ re-key to burstCast.

flags.estimate: crit true, core NOT credited (rider path, no core bucket).
flags.reasoning: Convention says function-damage riders get no core unless the text says 'core strike'. But this is not really a rider — it is the swap weapon's opening rocket, which in-game can land a core hit like any RL shot. Encoding it as flatDamage buys correct FB-exemption at the cost of the core bucket, and this single line is the largest term in her burst, so a mis-set core call is a big absolute error.
flags.recipe: Read the burst-cast popup colour/label in footage: a red 'CORE HIT' at the banner ⇒ the hit is core-eligible and needs a core-rate path (or an engine first-shot field on weaponSwap). Orange-only across several bursts ⇒ crit-only, as modeled.
